findings.detail: Deterministic integration validates the exact eight-file candidate and reports valid=true, with no writes applied.
The candidate resolves to evidence lock dbf46a5d7800757b17b0bdb6ddcfe23fe4e0b0731fe47a48ca566b77e509f921, matching the reviewed evidence record and its 57 locked references.
The four knowledge notes and four question notes use the active note types and registered domains; deterministic validation accepts their links, stable IDs, question dependencies and paths.
Each question has one assessable boolean intent with equivalent French and English wording, and its guidance matches the declared topic and dependency.
The manifest and reviewed evidence keep the release free of binding claims and legal interpretation; the knowledge notes state the guidance and research limits explicitly.
The manifest declares risk_tier strict and evidence_changes true, consistent with the evidence-bearing release.
